crossRefs.note: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped…
He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
translations.bsb: And when some shepherds came along and drove them away, Moses rose up to help them and watered their flock.
translations.kjv: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
translations.asv: And the shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
